title: Comment on: “Mixed reality-assisted orthognathic surgery with pre-bent titanium plates”
html: We read with great enthusiasm the recent technical note by Huang et al.1 entitled “Mixed reality-assisted orthognathic surgery with pre-bent titanium plates”. The authors present a compelling and innovative approach that merges virtual surgical planning with mixed reality, aiming to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of orthognathic surgery. The significant cost advantage of pre-bent standard plates over patient-specific implants is a particularly valuable point, especially for resource-conscious healthcare systems.
